summary: TCS released its Q1 FY 2025‑26 financial results, reporting a modest 1.3 % year‑over‑year rise in INR revenue to ₹634 370 million (USD $7 421 million) while constant‑currency revenue fell 3.1 %. Operating and net margins held steady at 24.5 % and 20.1 % respectively, with cash flow from operations exceeding net profit by 100.3 %. Demand remained strong, with the order book totaling $9.4 billion and a notable increase in mid‑tier clients (US$10 M+ up 9 % and US$1 M+ up 26 %). The company’s workforce reached 613,069 employees, with a 13.8 % attrition rate in IT services, and it maintained a diverse talent pool of 35.1 % women and 151 nationalities. Overall, TCS delivered solid profitability, healthy cash generation, and continued growth across its key geographies and verticals.
